Real-World Algorithm: Min-Max Feature Normalization
In machine learning, data science, and game UI health/progress meters, algorithms scale numbers from any arbitrary range into a clean 0 to 100 percentage scale using the Min-Max Normalization formula:

Mathematical Formula:
